papers.title: Microstructure Representation and Reconstruction of Heterogeneous Materials via Deep Belief Network for Computational Material Design
papers.abstract: Integrated Computational Materials Engineering (ICME) aims to accelerate optimal design of complex material systems by integrating material science and design automation. For tractable ICME, it is required that (1) a structural feature space be identified to allow reconstruction of new designs, and (2) the reconstruction process be property-preserving. The majority of existing structural presentation schemes rely on the designer's understanding of specific material systems to identify geometric and statistical features, which could be biased and insufficient for reconstructing physically meaningful microstructures of complex material systems. In this paper, we develop a feature learning mechanism based on convolutional deep belief network to automate a two-way conversion between microstructures and their lower-dimensional feature representations, and to achieves a 1000-fold dimension reduction from the microstructure space. The proposed model is applied to a wide spectrum of heterogeneous material systems with distinct microstructural features including Ti-6Al-4V alloy, Pb63-Sn37 alloy, Fontainebleau sandstone, and Spherical colloids, to produce material reconstructions that are close to the original samples with respect to 2-point correlation functions and mean critical fracture strength. This capability is not achieved by existing synthesis methods that rely on the Markovian assumption of material microstructures.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文不涉及生物医学植入物的应力遮挡、刚度匹配、LPBF制造或疲劳测试
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, or implant-related biomedical context; purely computational microstructure reconstruction without experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速复杂材料系统的优化设计，通过微观结构重建实现
summary_zh.method: 使用卷积深度信念网络自动学习微观结构的低维特征表示并进行重建
summary_zh.result: 实现了1000倍降维，重建的微观结构保持了两点相关函数和断裂强度
summary_zh.validation: 通过多种材料的原始样本对比验证了重建质量

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate optimal design of complex material systems by automating microstructure reconstruction that preserves material properties.
summary_en.method: A convolutional deep belief network learns a low-dimensional feature space for microstructures and enables bidirectional conversion between image space and feature space.
summary_en.result: The method achieves 1000-fold dimension reduction and reconstructs microstructures that match the original samples in two-point correlation functions and mean critical fracture strength.
summary_en.validation: Reconstructions are compared to original samples of Ti-6Al-4V, Pb63-Sn37, Fontainebleau sandstone, and spherical colloids using statistical functions and mechanical properties.

summary_en.motivation: To compare the electrocrystallization behavior of calcium phosphate on selective laser melted titanium versus commercially pure titanium.
summary_en.method: Calcium phosphate coatings were deposited on SLM Ti and CP Ti substrates via electrochemical deposition.
summary_en.result: The coating morphology and adhesion differed between SLM Ti and CP Ti surfaces.
summary_en.validation: Coatings were characterized using SEM and XRD.
